mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points in one month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through revenue growth catalysts.
